text: {"frames":["The mill in the Tower started turning at midnight, and there was not a breath of wind. Pim climbed the ladder to the sail room and found the great wheel still warm under her hand. On the floor below, someone had set out clogs in two rows, and a note pinned to the door said the rows must be checked before morning. The left row holds {a} clogs and the right row holds {b} clogs, and the mill will only stop turning once the rows are weighed against each other.","You pull the rope, and an empty boat bumps against the quay with a locked casket inside it. The lid is cold, and a tag tied to the handle reads: whoever opens me must first say which is more, the coins or the keys. Inside the casket there are {a} gold coins, and on a card beneath them is written the number of keys that will open it, which is {b}. You lay the coins and the keys side by side on the cold stone, ready to answer.","In the house with the hoist beam, every window is glowing, but the door is bolted from the inside and nobody answers your knock. Anke's cheeses have gone missing from the cellar shelf, and only the empty wooden board is left. Yesterday the shelf held {a} cheeses, and this morning you count only {b} cheeses on the board. The lamps hum softly as you stand there, and you have to decide what has really gone missing.","A rustle comes up from the cellar, and the smell of hot waffles drifts up the stairs with it. Every night a new shadow has crept across the wall of the Tower, and Bas has marked each one in chalk. On Monday the shadow had {a} windmill sails, and on Tuesday, when you held up the lamp, it had {b} sails. The chalk lines lie crooked on the stone, and the shadow is still there, waiting for you to look.","Lot unrolls an old map that nobody in Misty Ford remembers, and a canal runs across it where no canal should be. A small note in the corner asks for help at the lock before the ice comes. The map shows {a} locks on the canal, but the lock keeper's ledger in the Tower says only {b} locks. The water in the canal has begun to rise, and you hold the map and the ledger next to each other."]}
